about: The Instagram reel: a fast cut of the demo (src/demo), 1080×1920 at 30 fps, under a minute. Each scene starts at `start` (seconds, the start of its cross-fade in), Adam's line at `vo`; every effect is at `at` (seconds into the reel) and `moments` are the scenes' silent moments. These times are final: nothing is stretched to fit a line, so the picture never moves under a sound laid by ELEVENLABS-reel.md, which `npm run reel-cues` writes from this file.

scenes.shows: The black intro, fast: a line of light draws the icon from the first frame, “Study Stash” rises, glimpses of what’s to come float in, and the night lifts into the app

scenes.line: Hit record in class, and the words show up as they're said.
title: Hit record.
Words show up live.
scenes.shows: The Mac’s top right corner, close: the menu bar’s S. opens its dropdown; Record · BIO 110; the recorder’s pill; the recorder opens and the live words come in; “50 minutes later”; Stop
scenes.direction: bright, a little lift on "as they're said"

scenes.line: Stop, and your notes are written and filed for you, diagrams and all.
title: Notes, written for you.
Diagrams and all.
scenes.shows: BIO 110’s window: “Writing the notes…”; filed (the notes open, the notification “Filed in BIO 110”) with “Adding diagrams…”; “A minute later”; the diagram drops in; “Diagrams added”
scenes.direction: a small beat after "Stop", then easy

scenes.line: Point at a box, pin it, step through it, or test yourself.
title: Diagrams you explore.
Point, pin, step, test.
scenes.shows: The cardiac cycle diagram: a box lit with its neighbours, pinned (Explain this, Quiz me, Where was this said?, Zoom in); Step through, Next; Test yourself, a hidden box checked, Knew it
scenes.direction: a list with momentum, playful on "test yourself"

scenes.line: Drag a formula and watch it move.
title: Graphs you can drag.
Watch the formula move.
scenes.shows: CS 340’s notes: the sigmoid’s steepness dragged up to 5 and partway back

scenes.line: It can even draw what the lecture describes.
title: Labelled drawings.
Of what class describes.
scenes.shows: ENGR 120’s drone: the battery passed, the flight controller lit and pinned (its card)

scenes.line: Ask your lectures anything, and get answers from class.
title: Ask your lectures.
Answers from class.
scenes.shows: CS 101’s notes with the Ask bar: “What’s on the midterm?” typed and sent; the answer streams in from what was said

scenes.line: See what's due from Canvas, soonest first.
title: Canvas, connected.
What’s due, soonest first.
scenes.shows: Due: Lab 2 write-up marked Missing, then this week’s, soonest first; Lab 3 opened: due date, points, instructions, rubric

scenes.line: Your notes and what's due, on your phone too.
title: On your phone, too.
Notes and what’s due.
scenes.shows: The phone app: Library; a tap into The cardiac cycle’s notes; a tap on Due

scenes.line: Make it yours: rich notes, fast mode, after class.
title: Make it yours.
Notes your way.
scenes.shows: Settings → AI engines: Rich notes switched off; Claude Code speed → Fast mode; Recording: When it’s written down → After class
scenes.direction: relaxed, a little pause at the colon, then a quick list

scenes.line: Study Stash. Free for Mac and Windows.
scenes.shows: The end card: the icon, Study Stash, Free for Mac and Windows, study-stash-app.web.app, the marks for Mac and Windows; held to the last frame

sounds.prompt: Very soft, gentle airy whoosh for a slide transition, low and smooth, soft air moving, no hiss, no reverb tail
Very soft trackpad click, a single muted tap, close-miked, dry, no reverb, no high-pitched tick
Soft rounded start-recording sound, a low muted thup with a gentle rise, like a small button pressed into felt, dry, no beep, no bell, no chime
Soft rounded interface pop, like a small card settling into place, a gentle low wooden tok, dry, no bell, no chime, no reverb
Soft airy shimmer, a breath of light rising, like a gentle brush sweep over fine sand, warm and quiet, no bells, no chimes, no ringing tones
Soft friction of a small knob slid smoothly along a track, quiet and steady, close-miked, no clicks, no ticks
Quiet laptop typing, about two seconds of soft key presses, low muted thocks, a short sentence typed at an easy pace, dry, no clatter
One soft tap of a fingertip on a phone's glass screen, muted and rounded, very short, dry, no click, no tick
Warm soft swell of a felt piano and string pad chord in D major, rising gently over a second then fading over three seconds, calm and hopeful, no bells, no chimes, no percussion

effects.what: the S. in the menu bar opens its dropdown
recording starts: the recorder pill appears
filed in BIO 110: the notes open
the diagram drops into the notes
a box is pinned: its four actions appear
the sigmoid's steepness is dragged up, and partway back
the drone's flight controller is pinned
the Claude Code speed menu opens
When it's written down: After class

moments.what: the pointer rests on a box
